cues.say: Component 15: Connection pooler. Postgres handles only a few hundred connections. A pooler shares a small set of real connections among all your server copies. You'll bring this up during the spike defenses.
Think of it as: A few phone lines shared by a whole office. Use it for as soon as you add copies.
Here's a real scenario. Before the game, the pizza shop scales from 2 to 20 copies, 20 connections each.
Without it: 400 connections against a limit of 200.
Copies 11 to 20 can't connect and fail at kickoff.
With it: All 20 copies connect to the pooler.
It lends one out for the milliseconds a query takes.
Why it works: Scaling out the API multiplies connections unless something shares them.
In the interview, say: Postgres allows a few hundred connections. Without a pooler, scaling the API takes down the database.
A few related terms you may hear.
Short transactions: Never wait on Stripe while holding one.
